mapper.sql: SELECT d.*,v.version_no AS current_version_no,v.process_status AS latest_version_process_status,v.publish_status AS latest_version_publish_status FROM sa_document d LEFT JOIN sa_document_version v ON v.document_id=d.id AND v.id=d.current_published_version_idAND v.version_no=(SELECT MAX(v2.version_no) FROM sa_document_version v2 WHERE v2.document_id=d.id)
mapper.select: SELECT d.* FROM sa_document d WHERE d.id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM sa_document WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sa_document WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{knowledgeBaseId}AND current_published_version_id IS NOT NULL AND title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')AND status=#{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE sa_document SET update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
